scope: Unblinded census of all six posts and 19 discussion turns; selected evidence and all six current publisher pages checked.

diagnostics.stopReason: insufficient unused evidence or publisher diversity

limits: Editorial decisions are subjective, not accuracy percentages.
Different-source, same-model editions do not isolate a causal improvement.
Selected support is not the whole live prompt; current evidence reconstruction is explicitly retrospective.
Publisher agreement is not independent verification of every real-world assertion.
Psyche video not watched; its description was checked.
Manual run; historical observation-gate counts remain unchanged.
No published content was corrected in this review.

posts.title: The Free-Fruit Trial Judged by Wastage, Not Grocery Bills
posts.payoff: Competing measures of a school-food programme's success.
claims: Trial ended with wastage given as the reason
supported
Chunk 1 S2E6 and BBC page.
Cost-of-living effects never entered the decision
attribution_overreach
S2E1–E2 establishes a politician's belief, not an independently established account of the decision.
Ending the trial removed the help being discussed
missing_material_context
The page reports fruit being incorporated into a different school-food programme; the post omits this.
The measurement conflict is how such disputes usually start
unsupported_generalization
The selected support covers this dispute, not the usual cause of policy disputes.
discussion: Interesting visibility-versus-value lens, but assumes the programme was saving household money without selected evidence of actual savings.
Directly challenges the first turn using reported wastage; its banana is an illustrative example, not an invented reported event.
Useful evaluation question, but says one side counts savings when the source reports a concern that savings were not measured.

posts.title: Starshield Loses the Connection Above 100 mph
posts.payoff: A specific movement threshold interrupting connectivity in Ukraine.
claims: Investigation, Starshield identity and operational role
supported
Chunk 1 S3E7–E8.
Connections cut above 160 kph / 100 mph without warning on Thursday
supported
Chunk 1 S3E17.
Bandwidth caps and data quotas are familiar controls
not_in_selected_support
Background introduced without a supporting ID; unnecessary to explain the reported threshold.
The filter selects by movement rather than user
overgeneralized_scope
Selected evidence describes one restriction, not the absence of other filters. The current page reports Ukraine-specific application.
discussion: The suggestion that identity does not matter is stronger than the evidence and overlooks the reported geographic restriction.
Separates intent from effect and correctly avoids asserting the designer's motive.
Dependence on another party is a useful lens. Ownership is not in its selected S3E7–E8; the current source separately attributes US government ownership/control to Musk.

posts.title: The Postwar Slump That Had Jimmy Stewart Eyeing the Family Store
posts.payoff: Stewart considered his father's shop as a concrete alternative to acting.
claims: Director and wartime subject of Jimmy
supported
Chunk 1 S5E2.
Postwar uncertainty and possible return to Indiana, Pennsylvania
supported
Chunk 1 S5E3 and S5E17; the current page confirms both.
A more difficult, melancholy dramatic shape than a simple ascent
editorial_interpretation
Recognizable criticism about the premise, not a claim to have watched the film.
discussion: Frames a tension between service and career uncertainty. Hero is an evaluative description; the fuller source supplies wartime service details beyond the selected IDs.
Challenges the source's forgotten framing and focuses on the concrete fallback.
Develops what an actor would need to convey; does not claim the film achieved it.

posts.title: A Post Referencing Palestine Action Didn't Meet the Criminal Threshold, Police Say
posts.payoff: A police threshold assessment is distinct from approval of a statement.
claims: No further action and specialist assessment
supported
Chunk 1 S1E1–E2 and S1E6.
Criminal threshold is distinct from wisdom or defensibility
reasonable_interpretation
Useful but repeated at length rather than developed with source detail.
Who spoke and what was said
missing_reader_context
The page names Sarah Helm and describes her statement and its context; none appears in the body.
discussion: A decision not to pursue this post is narrower than saying the law had nothing to say about it.
Offers an institutional rationale, but mostly repeats the threshold point and speaks generally about how files arise without supporting evidence.

posts.title: Bettany: We Hadn't Spoken in Years When the Texts Were Read in Court
posts.payoff: Distance in a relationship does not answer responsibility for a person's messages.
claims: Bettany's account of estrangement and the interview's provenance
supported
Chunk 2 S2E1–E2 and S2E4.
Transcripts cannot establish ongoing contact, frequency or how people address one another
sweeping_claim
A limited historical exchange cannot establish the whole relationship; the generalized claim about transcripts is unnecessarily broad.
Every reader fills every gap in the record
unsupported_generalization
Rhetorical universal, not an established result of the reporting.
discussion: Repeats the body's travelling-evidence metaphor; asserts what the courtroom needed and makes an absolute claim about context.
Uses S2E10–E12 to introduce what Bettany wrote and separates its content from later estrangement.
Uses S2E13 for Depp's escalation and distinguishes easier relationship questions from responsibility for the words.
S2E3 and S2E5 support his silence, marriage duration and self-described quiet life; the reputation strategy is clearly a reading of those remarks.

posts.title: The Creative Prompts Aimed at Perfectionism, Not Inspiration
posts.payoff: Two usable creative prompts and an interpretation of why they lower the barrier to starting.
claims: Ten prompts, two examples and the named obstacles
supported
Chunk 3 S1E5–E6 and the Psyche video description.
Recasting a mistake as material and a question as a starting container
editorial_interpretation
Useful explanation of the named prompts; not a separately measured psychological effect.
The opening move rather than lack of ideas is what stops people
qualification_advisable
Framed as the writer's interpretation of the list; should remain a possible lens rather than a universal causal claim.
Walker identity
clarity_edit
Introduce Campbell Walker by full name. No video-content claims beyond the description were verified.
discussion: Compares how the two prompts tackle perfectionism; ease is an opinion, not an asserted study result.
Challenges the ease judgment and distinguishes starting from tolerating a mediocre result.
Draws a shared principle and marks the interpretation of the author's priorities with suggests.
